segments.title: How OLD is this brick bridge in Iraq?
segments.say: This brick bridge was just dug up in Iraq. How old is it? Eight hundred years, two thousand, or over three thousand eight hundred? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Over 3,800 years!
segments.say: Over three thousand eight hundred! It's named after King Sin-iddinam of Larsa.

segments.title: It crossed the main canal
segments.say: It crossed the city's main irrigation canal.

segments.title: Only HALF is dug up
segments.say: And only half of it is dug up so far.
